root_cause.text: The `mvpp2_bm_switch_buffers()` function unconditionally calls `mvpp2_bm_pool_update_priv_fc()` without checking if CM3 SRAM hardware is available, causing NULL pointer dereference when `priv->cm3_base` is NULL on devices without the CM3 SRAM resource in the device tree.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `&& priv->global_tx_fc` guards to both calls to `mvpp2_bm_pool_update_priv_fc()` in `mvpp2_bm_switch_buffers()`. The CVE description explicitly states that "Every other flow control call site in the driver already guards hardware access with either `priv->global_tx_fc` or `port->tx_fc`" and that "`mvpp2_bm_switch_buffers()` is the only place that omits this check." The crash occurs because `mvpp2_cm3_read()/mvpp2_cm3_write()` dereference `priv->cm3_base` without NULL checks, and when CM3 SRAM is absent, `priv->cm3_base` remains NULL while `priv->global_tx_fc` is false—a condition that should have prevented the hardware access but wasn't being checked in this one code path.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add null/state check to prevent calling flow control update when global TX flow control is not initialized.
intent_record.what: Added a second condition `&& priv->global_tx_fc` to the existing `if (change_percpu)` conditional check before calling `mvpp2_bm_pool_update_priv_fc(priv, false)`.
intent_record.how: The function `mvpp2_bm_pool_update_priv_fc()` will now only be invoked when both `change_percpu` is true AND `priv->global_tx_fc` is non-zero/true. Previously it was called whenever `change_percpu` alone was true, potentially operating on invalid or uninitialized flow control state when `global_tx_fc` was not set.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add guard condition to prevent flow control pool update when global transmit flow control is disabled.
intent_record.what: Added a second condition `&& priv->global_tx_fc` to the existing `if (change_percpu)` check before calling `mvpp2_bm_pool_update_priv_fc(priv, true)`.
intent_record.how: The function `mvpp2_bm_pool_update_priv_fc()` will now only be called when both `change_percpu` is true AND `priv->global_tx_fc` is non-zero/true. This prevents the function from executing when global transmit flow control is not enabled, avoiding potential incorrect state updates or operations on uninitialized flow control structures.

Author: Stefan Chulski <stefanc@marvell.com>

    net: mvpp2: Add TX flow control support for jumbo frames
    
    With MTU less than 1500B on all ports, the driver uses per CPU pool mode.
    If one of the ports set to jumbo frame MTU size, all ports move
    to shared pools mode.

bic_trace_step.reason: The commit introduces the function `mvpp2_bm_pool_update_priv_fc()` which is called unconditionally at lines 4951 and 4968 in `mvpp2_bm_switch_buffers()`. The new function iterates through ports and calls `mvpp2_bm_pool_update_fc()` without any check for CM3 SRAM hardware availability. The vulnerability root cause states that `mvpp2_bm_pool_update_fc()` internally accesses `priv->cm3_base` without null-checking it first. The commit adds calls to `mvpp2_bm_pool_update_priv_fc(priv, false)` and `mvpp2_bm_pool_update_priv_fc(priv, true)` without verifying that `priv->cm3_base` is not NULL, which will cause a NULL pointer dereference on devices without CM3 SRAM hardware. There is no conditional check (like `if (priv->cm3_base)`) before these function calls.
